overview: The Medford City Council met to address various municipal matters, including referring a Salem Street zoning amendment to the Community Development Board and passing the Values-Aligned Local Investment Ordinance on third reading. The Council also discussed the municipal waste removal contract, supported local nursing center workers, and initiated the recruitment process for a new City Clerk.

items.title: Approval of Meeting Records
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the August 5 and August 19, 2025 meetings, and tabled the minutes of the September 9, 2025 meeting.

items.title: License Petition: T Bar Nails and Lashes
items.summary: Approved a common victualler's license petition for T Bar Nails and Lashes at 61 Locust Street.

items.title: Support for Medford Rehabilitation and Nursing Center Workers
items.summary: Approved a resolution supporting union workers at the Medford Rehabilitation and Nursing Center in their contract negotiations and upcoming picket.

items.title: Municipal Waste Removal Contract Inquiry
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting an update from the administration regarding the municipal waste removal contract and its impact on townhouse condominium properties.

items.title: City Clerk Recruitment and Hiring Process
items.summary: Authorized the HR Director to post the City Clerk job description as amended, and tabled the resolution establishing the overall hiring process for one week to obtain a legal opinion on holding an executive session.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Heard public comments from residents on topics including city infrastructure, zoning, community outreach, and local support services.

items.title: Zoning Amendment: Salem Street Corridor
items.summary: Referred a proposed zoning amendment changing certain parcels in the Salem Street and Park Street node from MX2 to MX1 to the Community Development Board.

items.title: Executive Session: Minutes Review
items.summary: Entered executive session to review executive session minutes from the August 19, 2025 meeting.

items.title: Values-Aligned Local Investment Ordinance
items.summary: Ordained the Values-Aligned Local Investment Ordinance on third reading despite a late legal advisory from KP Law.
